collection.title: BMW 7 Series 2008 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW 7 Series 2008 to 2015 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
